Once M2 merges, `checklist-select since:v18.4` gives 34 runnable items (40 with `--include-blocked`). The QA seat's release-candidate run can start on M1 + M2 at any point; M3 and M4 add to it. This seat dispatches M3 as soon as #32259 merges.

## 专题收口 · Done · 2026-11-10T20:07Z

| Milestone | Child | Merged |
|:--|:--|:--|
| M1 · themes 1 and 3 | #32019 | #32035 |
| M2 · themes 2, 4 and 5 | #32020 | #32259 |
| M3 · themes 6, 7 and 8 | #32269 | #32299 |
| M4 · zero-citation packages + `coverage.json` close-out | #32270 | #32316 (`c3cf3955`) |

"Done when" is met. On main `7575116c`, `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json` returns **54** items, and **65** with `--include-blocked`. The seat ran both. `coverage.json` `releaseSweeps.v18.4` maps all eight themes to their items, and gives the reason for every blocked and planned one. No gate reads that key: it is the map for the release run.

Over the four milestones, M4 promoted one planned item (`api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address`) after a live verification run. Two items stay planned, each with its reason in `releaseSweeps`. One follow-up is carded: #32330, where eleven M1 items name scratch package ids with an underscore that `objectstack build` refuses. A runner substitutes the hyphen until that card lands.

Consumer `qa#2`: the release-candidate run can select `since:v18.4` on any sha from `c3cf3955` on. The seat closes this epic.
